title: Sentiment day-over-day delta (fresh catalyst) vs same-ticker next-day outcome

tables.name: Sentiment-delta buckets vs same-ticker next-day real outcome

notes: Genuinely small sample by construction -- requires the SAME ticker to reappear in the daily top-20 shortlist on an adjacent trading day, which is rare (only tickers whose composite score stays high two days running). Bucket thresholds are each source's own median absolute delta (adaptive, not a fixed number pulled from nowhere). Stone #3 of 6 in the user's 2026-08-18 'turn over every stone' sentiment review.

conclusion.summary: Pooled-sentiment delta correlation: 0.06047186420768161. LLM-score delta correlation: -0.2435402915994823. 'Jumped up' beats 'dropped' on both win-rate and avg-return: pooled=True, llm=False. At n=65 pairs this is a lead at best, not a verdict -- revisit once more repeat-ticker appearances accumulate.
